text: 🦀 Rewrite Projects In Rust Rust Anything helps rewrite games and apps from other languages in Rust. It works with Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, rewriting code in parts while checking that nothing breaks. ✔️ Designed for incremental code rewrites ✔️ Works with Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents ✔️ Checks rewritten parts for breakage ✔️ Rust programs can use less memory and system resources ✔️ Authors report up to 20x speedups in some tests 👉 Github 👈 Use it when you want to move an existing project to Rust without rewriting the whole codebase at once. 💻 @program

📱 Android Apps On iPhone Andarium can now run APK files on an iPhone by launching a virtual Android 17 environment. This makes it possible to try apps that are unavailable in the App Store, including some banking apps, depending on compatibility. ✔️ Virtual Android 17 runs directly on iPhone ✔️ Internet, camera, and microphone access are available ✔️ VPN must be disabled for Andarium to work properly 👉 Link 👈 App support depends on each APK, so compatibility may vary. 💻 @program

📱 OpenCode Comes To Smartphones OpenCode is now available on smartphones, letting you manage sessions and agents remotely while they keep running on your PC. Connect remote access with a QR code and continue working from your phone when you leave the computer. ✔️ Monitor the AI agent in real time ✔️ Send new tasks and approve or reject actions ✔️ Dictate explanations and send images ✔️ Continue active sessions from your phone 👉 Link 👈 Scan the QR code to connect your phone and keep control of OpenCode sessions from anywhere. 💻 @program
